card.name: Words just before the word adult
card.fires_on: Linking words or the start of ADULT, right before the word adult is expected, usually in contrast with child or pediatric. Seen in dose and radiation tables and in definitions of growing up.

modes.label: Linking word before adult
modes.description: A small word such as being, and, an, in or for that comes right before adult after a child or pediatric contrast.
modes.example: spend the years between being a child and<< being>> an adult.

modes.label: Start of ADULT in capitals
modes.description: The opening piece of the capitalized word ADULT in label headings and tables.
modes.example: PEDIATRIC PATIENTS UNLIKE<< AD>>ULT PATIENTS, PEDIAT

card.writes: It pushes the model to write the word adult next, and holds back unrelated pieces.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to say adult, especially when it is set against children.
